name: K. R. Narayanan
contribution: An Indian diplomat, academician, and statesman who served as the  president of India from 1997 to 2002 and vice president of India from 1992 to 1997.
image_credit: US EMBASSY NEW DELHI · Public domain

checks.lead: Kocheril Raman Narayanan  (27 October 1920 – 9 November 2005) was an Indian diplomat, academician, and statesman who served as the  president of India from 1997 to 2002 and vice president of India from 1992 to 1997.
